description: Home page hero: "Every agent. One workspace." with the animated violet dot background
Four agent windows working side by side on different projects, each with a different model
The Connections page: save a key once and choose which projects get it
A diff waiting for review: nothing is written until you accept
Three approval modes and what each lets an agent do without asking
The projects library with search, pins and status for every agent
One window, any model: a picker listing Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, Grok and local models
Nine features around your agents: every model, many windows, separate projects, reviewable edits, approval modes, code view, git, local models, connections
Six steps from adding projects to shipping: add projects, connect models, open a window per task, work in parallel, review, run and ship
Seven things the app enforces: no network access for the interface, ask first, local endpoints, encrypted keys, no telemetry
Three ways to connect a model: on your computer, with a key, or with the Claude and Codex tools you already use
Three principles: neutral, local and quiet
